Hi Lucy — thanks for the fast turnaround and for sending the attachments. A few quick clarifications before we finalize the PO: 

1) W-8BEN-E: our tax team flagged box 14 (chapter 3 status) — for a UK limited company we expect the entity to claim treaty benefits only if you have a US fixed base / branch. If you do not, we typically record the payee as 'Non-US corporation' without treaty claim. Can you confirm whether Thorpe claims treaty benefits for US-source income?

2) Certificate of Tax Residence looks fine, but we need the fiscal year end displayed on the cert or a note that it covers the 2025 tax year. The PDF you sent lists the registration but not the coverage year in the header. Can you confirm?

3) Signatory authority: thanks for the passport page. For our PO process we need an additional confirmation that the signatory can bind the company to contracts. A short signed statement on company letterhead (one paragraph) will work.

Once we have those three clarifications I can hand this to Procurement to complete PO creation. Target SLA for PO issuance is 2 business days after evidence is confirmed.

If it's easier, feel free to reply inline to the PDF and re-upload.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
